$identity: Stage V V5 IPC contract gate allowlist. Each top-level array (other than non_literal_push) holds objects of shape { channel, reason, owner, expiry }. non_literal_push entries are { callsite: 'file:line', variable, channels[], reason, owner, expiry }. expiry is YYYY-MM-DD; expired entries fail the gate.

invoke_only.reason: Channel is dual-registered as ipcMain.handle + ipcMain.on in src/main/modules/browser-engine/ipc-shell.ts:152-157; renderer (src/preload/index.ts:337) only uses ipcRenderer.send (fire-and-forget bounds sync per CLAUDE.md §2 BrowserView overlay rule). The orphan handle() pre-dates the fire-and-forget migration and is retained as a defensive request/response stub. Stage-W will remove the legacy handle() registration.

Same dual-registration pattern as browser:updateBounds at src/main/modules/browser-engine/ipc-shell.ts:217-226; renderer (src/preload/index.ts:360) uses ipcRenderer.send. Legacy handle() to be removed in stage-W cleanup.

src/main/modules/search-engine/ipc-handler.ts:250 registers a defensive cancel-reindex handler intended for workspace-close / app-quit teardown. No renderer caller exists today; the UI path that should invoke it is part of the search-engine lifecycle work scheduled for stage-W. Removing the handler now would lose the cancel hook before its replacement lands.
